name: Pair of Thieves
known_for: Value Packs of Underwear and Socks

prices.note: boxer-briefs products.json: 60 listings, all regular-price and in stock; every listing is a multipack (2- or 3-pack). 4-Way Stretch Every Day Kit Cotton Stretch Boxer Briefs (3-Pack) $14.99; SuperFit Sport Boxer Briefs (2-Pack) $26.99 (polyester-spandex jersey with mesh vents). Sizes S–XL on all, 2XL on 51, 3XL and 4XL on 37, XS on 3.

notes: About us: started 2013 by three friends; 'Our goods live at the overlap of style, comfort, and value.'
Terms: the site is operated by Stateside Merchants, LLC, owner of the Pair of Thieves brand (a US LLC; basis for hq_country US, HQ city not stated).
Shipping policy: standard $7.95 under $70, free on $70+; 3-day expedited $30, free on $130+. No international destinations stated, so ships_to records the US only.

Refund policy, No Regrets Guarantee: send it back within 101 days of purchase from its website for a full refund or exchange, including free US return shipping, regardless of the product's condition. Black Friday, Cyber Monday and Final Sale purchases may be excluded; third-party retailer purchases are not eligible.
